description: Save sorted Shoot Board photos to the library as garments, avatars, locations or reference files, skip ones already saved, and add them to the Shoot Board at expected_revision; a board that changed is refused before anything is saved (revision_conflict with the current board).

board_id.description: The open Shoot Board's board_id, from Open Shoot Board or your context.

expected_revision.description: Board revision this write is based on; a stale revision returns a revision_conflict error with the current board instead of overwriting it

items.description: Photos to save, each with its confirmed kind

image_url.description: Public HTTP(S) URL of the uploaded image (host file download URL, or the image_url mcp_upload_intake_photo returned)

name.description: Display name for the saved asset

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the file bytes, computed by the widget

name: mcp_commit_intake
title: Save Dropped Photos
